firstIntoTheAge.name: First Into the Age
firstIntoTheAge.text: The first empire in the world to reach a new age.

firstMarvelOfTheAge.name: The First Marvel
firstMarvelOfTheAge.text: The first wonder finished in the world during an age.

theFirstFaith.name: The First Faith
theFirstFaith.text: The first religion founded in the world.

theFallenPalace.name: The Fallen Palace
theFallenPalace.text: The first empire to take a rival's seat of government.

theFirstScholar.name: The First Scholar
theFirstScholar.text: The first scholar called into the world.

theFirstGeneral.name: The First General
theFirstGeneral.text: The first general called into the world.

theFirstMerchant.name: The First Merchant
theFirstMerchant.text: The first merchant called into the world.

theFirstArtist.name: The First Artist
theFirstArtist.text: The first artist called into the world.

theGreatCityOfTheWorld.name: The Great City
theGreatCityOfTheWorld.text: The first city in the world to hold fifteen citizens.

theEngine.name: The Engine
theEngine.text: The first empire to complete the Engine.
theEngine.dormant: The Engine has no row in the tree yet.

theGoldenBead.name: The Golden Bead
theGoldenBead.text: The last bead on the rod. Only the empire that finishes the Magnum Opus mints it, and finishing the Opus closes the age.

theClosingWork.name: The Closing Work
theClosingWork.source: Completing Alchemy, the last technology of the age.
theClosingWork.text: Every empire that reaches the end of the chart is paid for the journey.

theStarChart.name: The Star Chart
theStarChart.text: The sky written down, and every ship of the realm sailing by it.

theTurningHeavens.name: The Turning Heavens
theTurningHeavens.text: The earth is not the centre of anything, and the scholars who proved it are famous for it.

theCodex.name: The Codex
theCodex.text: Everything the workshops learned, bound in one book and issued to the army.

censusOfTheWorld.name: The Census of the World
censusOfTheWorld.flavor: Every soul in the realm, set down in one hand.
censusOfTheWorld.text: A race. Needs a city of fifteen citizens. The first empire to finish gains a citizen in every city.

theGreatGames.name: The Great Games
theGreatGames.flavor: The whole world comes to watch, and forgets to fight.
theGreatGames.text: A race. Needs funeral games in every city. The first empire to finish keeps a lasting step of contentment.

theGrandCaravan.name: The Grand Caravan
theGrandCaravan.flavor: One road, and the whole of it yours.
theGrandCaravan.text: A race. Needs ten caravans on the road at once. The first empire to finish may keep more of them thereafter.

theGrandSatrapy.name: The Grand Satrapy
theGrandSatrapy.flavor: Govern a province and you govern a people; govern ten and you govern a world.
theGrandSatrapy.text: A race. Needs ten cities. The first empire to finish keeps a lasting step of contentment and of authority.

theCathedralOfTheAge.name: The Cathedral of the Age
theCathedralOfTheAge.flavor: Stone raised so high the argument stops.
theCathedralOfTheAge.text: A race. Needs a cathedral in every city. The first empire to finish is sent a prophet.

theEncyclopaedia.name: The Encyclopaedia
theEncyclopaedia.flavor: Everything known, in the order it was found.
theEncyclopaedia.text: A race. Needs a university in every city. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of learning.
deferred: A free technology of the current age — a research grant is banked as beakers instead.

theMint.name: The Mint
theMint.flavor: A coin is a promise that everyone has agreed to keep.
theMint.text: A race. Needs a mint in every city. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of gold.
deferred: Cheaper purchases for a spell — a timed empire effect the boon vocabulary does not carry.

theMusterOfTheRealm.name: The Muster of the Realm
theMusterOfTheRealm.flavor: Every spear counted, every spear sharpened.
theMusterOfTheRealm.text: A race. Needs an armoury in three cities. The first empire to finish fights a little harder ever after.

theExposition.name: The Exposition
theExposition.flavor: Come and see what we have made of the world.
theExposition.text: A race. Needs six wonders held. The first empire to finish banks a great sum of culture.

theRoadBuilder.name: The Road-Builder
theRoadBuilder.text: Bind the realm together by road.

theFounder.name: The Founder
theFounder.text: Found eight cities of your own. Cities taken from others do not count.

threeOfTheAge.name: Three of the Age
threeOfTheAge.text: Hold three wonders of the age the world stands in.

theScholarsWager.name: The Scholar's Wager
theScholarsWager.text: Stand two whole ages ahead of the most backward empire in the world.

theLibraryOfTheRealm.name: The Library of the Realm
theLibraryOfTheRealm.text: Hold a library and a university in four cities.

theWaterworks.name: The Waterworks
theWaterworks.text: Hold an aqueduct in four cities of ten citizens or more.

theSurveyor.name: The Surveyor
theSurveyor.text: Buy twenty hexes of ground across the game.
deferred: One more claimed hex for every city — a border grant in every town at once.

theApostle.name: The Apostle
theApostle.text: Have your faith followed by twenty citizens in cities you do not own.

theHierophant.name: The Hierophant
theHierophant.text: Spend a great sum of faith on augurs and prophets across the game.

theTithe.name: The Tithe
theTithe.text: Gather a great sum of gold from tithes.

theScholarship.name: The Scholarship
theScholarship.text: Gather a great sum of learning from scholarship.

thePatron.name: The Patron
thePatron.text: Plant three great works so that each one touches the other two.

theDeepening.name: The Deepening
theDeepening.text: Raise an Order to its third level and keep it slotted for ten turns together.

theLongReign.name: The Long Reign
theLongReign.text: Keep a council whose slotted Orders total fifteen levels for ten turns together.
deferred: A free Order draft — a draft handed over outright is not in the boon vocabulary.

theBreadbasket.name: The Breadbasket
theBreadbasket.text: Keep one city fed to a hundred of food for ten turns together.

theForgeCity.name: The Forge-City
theForgeCity.text: Keep one city working to a hundred of production for ten turns together.

theMetropolis.name: The Metropolis
theMetropolis.text: Grow a city to twenty citizens.

theTwelve.name: The Twelve
theTwelve.text: Hold twelve cities of six citizens or more.

theLegacy.name: The Legacy
theLegacy.text: Hold fifteen legacies that have not been struck from the record.
deferred: Every struck legacy of yours restored — a revocation is marked, and unmarking it is not a boon shape.

theLaureatesCourt.name: The Laureate's Court
theLaureatesCourt.text: Plant a great work of every family inside one city's ground.

theDynasty.name: The Dynasty
theDynasty.text: Call six great people during one age.

theEnhancer.name: The Enhancer
theEnhancer.text: Enhance your faith, and see a rival's seat of government take it up.

theStandingArmy.name: The Standing Army
theStandingArmy.text: Keep twenty fighting units under arms for ten turns together.

theMostCities.name: The Most Cities
theMostCities.text: At the close of the age, the empire holding the most cities.

theMostCalled.name: The Most Called
theMostCalled.text: At the close of the age, the empire that called the most great people during it.

theGreatestCity.name: The Greatest City
theGreatestCity.text: At the close of the age, the empire holding the largest city.

theRichestRoads.name: The Richest Roads
theRichestRoads.text: At the close of the age, the empire whose caravans carried the most during it.

theDeepestLearning.name: The Deepest Learning
theDeepestLearning.text: At the close of the age, the empire that completed the most technologies of it.

theWidestFaith.name: The Widest Faith
theWidestFaith.text: At the close of the age, the empire whose faith is followed by the most citizens abroad.

theMostMarvels.name: The Most Marvels
theMostMarvels.text: At the close of the age, the empire holding the most wonders of it.

theStrongestArm.name: The Strongest Arm
theStrongestArm.text: At the close of the age, the empire whose army is worth the most in the field.
